excerpt.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
excerpt.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
texts.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.

texts.zh:
毫无疑问，生机勃勃的生态圈并非[Root.Capital.GetName]独有。无论是科学界，还是民众，都迫切想要了解散布在星系中的各种外星生命。

对已知生命体的分类统计工作正在进行中，但我们的外星生物学家一直在催促我集中精力勘测宜居世界。
texts.en:
We now know without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Efforts to catalog the life forms we encounter are already underway, but our xenobiologists have urged us to focus our planetary survey efforts on habitable, life-bearing worlds.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

texts.zh: 我们的外星生物学家敦促我们调查所有发现存在生物圈的星球。他们渴望更深入地了解星系中的各种外星生态系统。
texts.en: Our xenobiologists have urged us to survey any worlds with an active biosphere that we come across. They are eager to learn more about the diverse alien ecosystems found throughout the galaxy.
